notes.title: We fixed it! Really...
notes.content:
In this update we
- Added support for gamepads (choose your controller type in the settings)
- Fixed some blocking bugs
- Added some information in  planner
- Presentation will no longer disappear
- Choose of level of pixelation more obvious now

And also fixed other minor bugs 

ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:
Another update!

[/list]
